name: Vyletongue Corruption
summary: Vark Battlescar asks you to tend the corrupted plants in Maraudon. The orange crystal pool and Vylestem Vines are tied to the work.

sections.title: Vark’s Request
sections.body: In Shadowprey Village, Vark Battlescar asks you to heal plants afflicted by corruption. He gives you a Coated Cerulean Vial to fill at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon. The vial is meant for the Vylestem Vines, where corrupted Noxxious Scions emerge.

sections.title: The Plants
sections.body: The Noxxious Scions are tied to healing the plants. After eight plants are healed, you can return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

faq.q: What does Vark Battlescar ask me to do?
aliases: what do I do for Vark
faq.answer: Vark Battlescar asks you to heal eight plants afflicted by corruption in Maraudon, then return to him in Shadowprey Village.

faq.q: Where do I get the Cerulean Vial?
faq.answer: Vark Battlescar hands you the Coated Cerulean Vial, and you fill it at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.

faq.q: What are the Vylestem Vines for?
faq.answer: Using the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines brings out a corrupted Noxxious Scion.
The plants are healed by killing the corrupted Noxxious Scions that emerge from the Vylestem Vines.
Eight plants need healing before you return to Vark Battlescar.
Vark Battlescar is in Shadowprey Village.
